summary: Full E2E test of Area QR feature (backend + frontend) for Nyla Air Water CRM. Backend script /app/backend/tests/manual_area_scan.py passes end-to-end: GET /api/maintenance/areas/stickers returns qr data-uri + equipment_count/scheduled_count; GET /api/maintenance/area-scan/{areaId} returns 401 without auth; POST /area-scan/{areaId}/complete with X-Staff-Token properly skips photo_required ('Photo inspection required'), not-assigned ('Only assigned maintenance staff'), duplicate ('Already recorded today'), completes eligible with performed_via='area_qr'; admin bypass sets is_admin=true and can_tick=true for all rows. Frontend E2E (Playwright) on preview URL: (1) Admin → /equipment-master → 'Area QR' button (eq-area-qr-btn) opens dialog (area-qr-dialog) grouped by facility › floor with per-area rows (area-qr-row-<id>), 'Print all 8 area stickers' (area-qr-print-all) and per-area Print (area-qr-print-<id>); clicking Print calls window.open (confirmed via stub). (2) Fresh context (no app session) → /area-scan/<areaId> shows StaffScanLogin (staff-scan-login); since face_available=false in headless, roster picker appears directly with roster = union of staff assigned to equipment in area (ZZ FE Area Staff + ZZ FE Other Staff). Pick staff m1 → PIN 2468 → Sign in → area-scan-page loads with area name FINISHED GOODS, summary chips (3 due / 0 done), 'Recording as ZZ FE Area Staff' chip with Switch. Equipment badges match spec: Pump A (assigned m1) = Due today + checkbox pre-checked; Pump B (unassigned) = Due today + checkbox; Filter C (assigned m2) = 'Assigned to others' greyed with 'Assigned to ZZ FE Other Staff', no checkbox. 'Select all due' toggles Mark 0 ↔ Mark 3. Ticking A only + 'Mark 1 as Maintenance Complete' → result card (area-complete-result) 'ZZ FE Area Pump A' completed; list refreshes: A shows 'Done · By ZZ FE Area Staff · 22:07', no checkbox. (3) Setting maintenance_slots.photo_required=true on eB in Mongo and reloading: B shows 'Needs photo' badge, no checkbox, and 'open equipment check-in' link (area-eq-open-<id>) href=/maintenance-scan/<token>. (4) Admin (app session) → /area-scan/<areaId> directly skips staff sign-in, chip = 'Recording as System Admin · admin', can tick C (admin bypass). All temp data (equipment_master, qc_team, maintenance_slots, maintenance_records, factory_staff_sessions) cleaned up post-test.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AreaQrDialog.js DialogContent triggers Radix a11y warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — consider adding <DialogDescription> for a11y compliance. Non-blocking.

Minor: Unassigned equipment (no maintenance staff set) is tickable by any signed-in staff on the area page (Pump B was 'Due today' + checkbox for m1 even though m1 wasn't assigned). Backend behaviour is consistent (can_tick=true when no assignees), but confirm this is intended — user story reads 'each equipment only tickable by its assigned staff'. If unassigned equipment should be admin-only, tighten _tickable in maintenance_sheets.area_scan.

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 3 equipment (ZZ FE Area Pump A/B, Filter C) + 2 qc_team members (ZZ FE Area Staff / ZZ FE Other Staff) in existing area Factorty › Ground Floor › Finished Goods; all removed with associated slots/records/sessions after test.
